name: Child Support
overview: Scripture affirms that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as His reward (Psalms 127:3). The responsibility of child support extends beyond provision of physical needs, encompassing dedicated training and nurturing according to God's ways (Proverbs 22:6; Ephesians 6:4). Fathers are called to lovingly provide for their children’s needs without provoking them to anger (Luke 11:11; Ephesians 6:4), and to faithfully shepherd their family, avoiding neglect that brings judgment (Zechariah 11:17). Together, these verses emphasize a God-centered, diligent, and compassionate approach to supporting and raising children.
